Jamie: Anyone up for a Monday playoff watch party? Kitchen projector + wings at 6:30pm. Also fantasy semis same night — can we trade snack duty instead of doing the usual waiver chaos?
Marta: Count me in. I'll bring a veggie tray if someone else does wings :heart:
Devin: I got wings (hot + mild). Tiny wager idea: loser brings bagels to the office next week? :smirk:
Ryan: Deal. Quick fantasy q tho — start Antonio over Miles? Need to lock my lineup.
Sophia: Start Miles. Hurts looked a bit gimpy in the practice notes this morning. Source: https://nflnotes.example.com/updates
Devin: Thanks — swapping Hurts for Miles then. @Jamie where do we put the bet money? Venmo ok?
Jamie: Venmo is fine. I'll spin up a tiny Google form for snack signups: https://forms.gle/snacks123
OpsBot: Reminder: kitchen projector reserved 6:15–9:30pm. Please log cleanup afterwards! :white_check_mark:
Ryan: PS prediction: total under/over? I'm taking the over 48.5 — bold move :money_with_wings:
Marta: LOL @Ryan you're always optimistic :joy: Also can someone bring plates + napkins?
Sophia: I can bring napkins and paper plates. @Marta vegetarian dip incoming :thumbsup:
Jamie: Awesome. See y'all Monday — going to pin the form and stash this thread as the snack tracker.
